test_title: PYST 12 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 17 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

__**Forty lakhs are the amount**__ one needs in order to pursue overseas education.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Forty lakhs is the amount**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• The word "**is**" is the correct verb form for the singular subject "**amount**."
 
• The subject of the sentence, "**Forty lakhs**," refers to a singular amount, requiring the singular verb "**is**."
 
• **Options 2, 3**, and 4 are grammatically incorrect due to mismatched subject-verb agreement.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"Forty lakhs is the amount one needs in order to pursue overseas education."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "Forty lakh were the amount"** is incorrect because "were" is used for plural subjects, but "amount" is singular.
 
• **Option 3: "Forty lakhs have the amount"** is incorrect because "have" does not fit the context or grammatical structure.
 
• **Option 4: "Forty lakhs has the amount"** is incorrect because the verb "has" does not align with the sentence structure.
